sources.title: GitHub - abudesai/timeVAE: TimeVAE implementation in keras/tensorflow
sources.snippet: TimeVAE is a model designed for generating synthetic time-series data using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) architecture with interpretable components like level, trend, and seasonality. This repository includes the implementation of TimeVAE, as well as two baseline models: a dense VAE and a convolutional VAE.

sources.title: [2111.08095] TimeVAE: A Variational Auto-Encoder for Multivariate Time ...
sources.snippet: Recent work in synthetic data generation in the time-series domain has focused on the use of Generative Adversarial Networks. We propose a novel architecture for synthetically generating time-series data with the use of Variational Auto-Encoders (VAEs). The proposed architecture has several distinct properties: interpretability, ability to encode domain knowledge, and reduced training times ...
